info.description: Internal car-rental back-office API: fleet registry, rental contracts, preventive maintenance, rate cards, invoicing and deposits, multi-branch rollup, analytics, audit trail. Capability routes require a tenant bearer token; a missing or unbound token is HTTP 401. Every capability answer carries its authority layer (precedence.v1).
